summary: A small lowercase label for a category, tag, or filter.
purpose: Use to mark a piece of content with a free-form category or to offer a filter. Reach for it instead of a raw MUI Chip so the masking-tape aesthetic and semantic colors stay on-system.

anatomy.description: The tape-styled chip; near-sharp corners, optional slight rotation.

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color, mapped to the status and action tokens.

props.name: tape
props.description: Apply the slight tape-like rotation on solid tags.

props.name: size
props.description: Tag size, strictly mapped to layout-height tokens.

variants.name: solid
variants.description: Low-opacity color fill with a matching border.
variants.whenToUse: Default content tags on a card or the wall of worries.

variants.name: outline
variants.whenToUse: Filter chips and section headers where the tag should read as quieter.

variants.name: ghost
variants.whenToUse: Dense contexts where borders would add noise.

whenToUse: Labeling content with a free-form category such as money, guilt, avoidance.
Offering a filter the user can select.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Showing a numeric count or status dot

do: Keep labels short, one or two words.
Use the semantic color prop, not a hardcoded value.
Limit a card to about five tags.
dont: Use Tag as a clickable action.
Capitalize labels; the component lowercases them by design.

content.voice: Plain, lowercase, human. Real worries, not clinical categories.

tokensUsed.usage: Font, size, and weight of the label.

keyboard: Non-interactive by default; not in the tab order unless made selectable.
aria: Purely decorative tags need no role.
Do not encode meaning in color alone; the label carries it.
accessibility.contrast: Label-to-background contrast holds at least 4.5:1 in every color.
accessibility.focus: No focus state unless used as an interactive filter.

related.whenToChoose: Use Badge for a count or status indicator; Tag is for a category label.
Use Button when selecting the tag should perform an action.
